title: Escrow payouts: 12 rules in 3 modules
subtitle: TLA+ properties for deposits, disputes and payouts
provenanceNote: Illustrative sample: statuses and the TLC-style counterexample were written by hand; no checker was run.

modules.title: Deposits & holds
modules.summary: Funding escrows and holding the money.

rules.title: An escrow opens only with the minimum deposit

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: A $100 deposit meets the minimum exactly, so the escrow opens.

preview.alert: Escrow opened.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: An escrow opens with $40, below the $100 minimum.

preview.alert: Fees exceed the escrowed amount.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Deposits under the minimum are rejected with the shortfall shown.

preview.alert: Deposit at least $100 to open an escrow.

evidence.ruleSummary: Every open escrow holds at least the minimum deposit.
evidence.ifEnforced: No escrow is too small to cover its fees.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: Tiny escrows cost more to run than they hold.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: A buyer’s open exposure stays at or under $10k

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: With $8k already open, a $2k deposit lands exactly on the $10k cap.

preview.alert: Within the exposure cap.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: Each deposit is checked alone, so the buyer’s open exposure reaches $11.5k.

preview.alert: Risk exposure exceeds policy.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Deposits that would push exposure past $10k go to manual review.

preview.alert: This deposit needs a risk review.

evidence.ruleSummary: The sum of a buyer’s open escrows is at most $10,000.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: One buyer can concentrate unlimited risk across many escrows.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: A retried deposit is applied once

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: A new idempotency key credits the escrow once.

preview.alert: Deposit received.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The client retries after a timeout and the escrow is credited twice.

preview.alert: The escrow shows money that was never sent.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: A reused key returns 409 Conflict with the original result.

preview.alert: Already processed. Returning the original deposit.

evidence.ruleSummary: Each idempotency key credits an escrow at most once.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run
evidence.sourceQuote: Servers MUST treat a repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key as the original request.

rules.title: Funds stay held until both parties confirm

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: Buyer and seller both confirmed delivery, so funds go to the seller.

preview.alert: Funds released to the seller.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The seller alone triggers the release before the buyer confirms.

preview.alert: The buyer paid for goods not yet received.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Funds stay held until the buyer confirms too.

preview.alert: Waiting for the buyer to confirm.

evidence.ruleSummary: An escrow is released only after both buyer and seller confirm.
evidence.ifEnforced: Neither side can take the money alone.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: No payout while a dispute is open

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: There is no dispute, so the queued payout is sent.

preview.alert: Payout sent.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The dispute opens after the payout was queued, and the payout is still sent.

preview.alert: Money left escrow during an open dispute.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: The dispute is checked again at send time, so the payout is frozen.

preview.alert: Frozen until the dispute is resolved.

evidence.ruleSummary: While an escrow has an open dispute, no payout from it is sent.
evidence.ifEnforced: Disputed money stays in escrow until an arbiter decides.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: A race between queueing and disputing lets money leave escrow.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run
evidence.counterexample:
Error: Invariant InvNoReleaseDuringDispute is violated.
State 1: <Initial predicate>
  escrow = [E7 |-> "funded"], dispute = [E7 |-> FALSE], queue = <<>>
State 2: <EnqueuePayout(E7)>
  queue = <<E7>>
State 3: <OpenDispute(E7)>
  dispute = [E7 |-> TRUE]
State 4: <SendPayout(E7)>
  escrow = [E7 |-> "paid"], dispute = [E7 |-> TRUE]

rules.title: Disputes can be opened for 14 days after delivery

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: Day 14 is the last day of the window, so the dispute opens.

preview.alert: Dispute opened.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: A dispute opened 40 days after delivery freezes a long-settled escrow.

preview.alert: A settled escrow is reopened.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Requests after day 14 are refused with the deadline shown.

preview.alert: The dispute window closed on 15 Nov.

evidence.ruleSummary: A dispute is opened at most 14 days after delivery.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: Old transactions can be frozen at any time.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: Evidence submitted after the deadline is not considered

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: Evidence uploaded 60 hours in is on time.

preview.alert: Evidence attached to the case.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: Evidence uploaded after the deadline still sways the decision.

preview.alert: One party gets extra time the other did not.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Late evidence is kept on file but excluded from the decision.

preview.alert: Submitted after the 72-hour deadline.

evidence.ruleSummary: Only evidence uploaded within 72 hours of the dispute opening is considered.
evidence.ifEnforced: Both parties get the same time to respond.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: Only an assigned arbiter can resolve a dispute

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: Avery is the assigned arbiter, so the decision is recorded.

preview.alert: Decision recorded.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The seller’s own support login resolves the dispute in their favor.

preview.alert: A party decided its own dispute.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Only the assigned arbiter can resolve the case.

preview.alert: Only the assigned arbiter can resolve this dispute.

evidence.ruleSummary: A dispute is resolved only by its assigned arbiter.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: Parties can rule on their own disputes.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: An escrow is paid out exactly once

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: The first job run pays out the escrow.

preview.alert: Payout sent.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: A restarted job pays the same escrow again.

preview.alert: The seller received the money twice.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: The ledger shows the escrow as paid, so the restart skips it.

preview.alert: Already paid out. Nothing to do.

evidence.ruleSummary: Every escrow has at most one successful payout.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: Crashes and restarts pay sellers twice.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: Payouts never exceed the escrow balance

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: The payout equals the balance, leaving exactly zero.

preview.alert: Escrow settled.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The fee is added on top, so the payout exceeds the balance by $50.

preview.alert: The platform covers the gap from its own funds.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: The fee is deducted from the payout instead of added to it.

preview.alert: Fee deducted from the payout.

evidence.ruleSummary: An escrow balance never goes below zero.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: Payouts go only to a verified bank account

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: The seller’s account passed verification, so the payout is sent.

preview.alert: Payout sent to ...4021.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: A bank account added minutes ago receives the payout without verification.

preview.alert: Funds may be going to a fraudster.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: New accounts must pass verification before receiving money.

preview.alert: Held until the new account is verified.

evidence.ruleSummary: Every payout targets a bank account that has passed verification.
evidence.ifNotEnforced: Changing the bank account is enough to steal a payout.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run

rules.title: Payouts wait until the dispute window closes

normal.label: Normal
normal.takeaway: The window closed yesterday, so the payout goes out.

preview.alert: Payout sent after the dispute window.

bug.label: Bug
bug.takeaway: The seller is paid the day after delivery, before the buyer can dispute.

preview.alert: A later dispute has no money left to freeze.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.takeaway: Payouts are scheduled for the day after the window closes.

preview.alert: Scheduled for 15 Nov.

evidence.ruleSummary: Every payout happens after its dispute window closes, and eventually does happen.
evidence.ifEnforced: Disputes always have money to freeze.
evidence.method: Illustrative sample: hand-written to show a TLC-style board; no checker was run
